Container.Name: imap-cleanup-tool
Container.Overview: IMAP Cleanup Tool - Self-hosted email filter with web UI. Move, organize, and clean emails from any IMAP account.
Container.Description:
IMAP Cleanup Tool with web UI for managing email filters. Move emails between folders, create rules by sender/subject/date, and automate inbox cleanup. Works with ANY IMAP provider (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, mailbox.org, etc.).
SECURITY RECOMMENDATIONS: - Access via SSH tunnel: ssh -L 8765:127.0.0.1:8000 user@unraid-ip - Or use Nginx Proxy Manager with Basic Auth - Use App Password or OAuth2 when available from your email provider
CONFIGURATION: 1. Install via Community Apps after adding TemplateURL 2. Configure IMAP credentials for your provider 3. Access web UI at http://unraid-ip:8000 4. Create rules to move emails based on age, sender, subject, etc. 5. Test rules manually before enabling automation
COMMON IMAP PROVIDERS: - Gmail: imap.gmail.com:993 (SSL) - Outlook/Hotmail: outlook.office365.com:993 (SSL) - Yahoo: imap.mail.yahoo.com:993 (SSL) - iCloud: imap.mail.me.com:993 (SSL) - mailbox.org: imap.mailbox.org:993 (SSL) - ProtonMail: via Bridge: 127.0.0.1:1143 (SSL)
